# meok-eu-ai-act-art-26-fria-mcp

> MEOK EU AI Act Article 26(9) Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment generator. Auto-generates a FRIA per Article 27(1) 9 mandatory elements. Cross-walks to GDPR Art 35 DPIA + ISO 42005. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_fria_required
- generate_fria
- list_art_27_elements
- list_annex_iii_categories
- crosswalk_to_dpia
- sign_fria_chain

## Install
```
pip install meok-eu-ai-act-art-26-fria-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-eu-ai-act-art-26-fria-mcp/
